summary: Quoin Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting that on September 8, 2026 the FDA granted Rare Pediatric Disease designation to QRX003 for Peeling Skin Syndrome, the second such designation after Netherton Syndrome. The disclosure was furnished under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD) and Item 8.01 (Other Events), with a supporting press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, securities issuance, shareholder vote, or change of control is involved. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or structural terms appear. The event is a regulatory milestone; no deal or arbitrage angle exists.
